riskManagementFramework.definition: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, and mitigating threats to The Corporate Desk's revenue, reputation, cash flow, and operational capability
riskManagementFramework.approach: Proactive — risks are identified before projects begin, not managed reactively when they materialise
riskManagementFramework.riskRegister: Maintain a live risk register with each risk rated: Likelihood (1–5) × Impact (1–5) = Risk Score. Review monthly.

topBusinessRisks.description: TCD's performance depends heavily on one or two key individuals — if they leave or are unavailable, operations suffer
mitigation: Document all processes — quoting, ordering, installation coordination — so anyone can follow them
Cross-train at least one person on every critical function
Involve multiple team members in client relationships where possible

topBusinessRisks.description: If TCD relies too heavily on one supplier for a product category, a supplier failure creates immediate product gap
mitigation: Maintain at least 2 qualified suppliers per major product category
Never commit >70% of annual volume to a single supplier
Maintain approved backup suppliers with current pricing on file

topBusinessRisks.description: If >40% of annual revenue comes from one client, losing that client would be business-threatening
mitigation: Actively diversify pipeline — cap any single client at 35% of annual revenue
Build recurring relationship touchpoints with all major accounts

topBusinessRisks.risk: Economic downturn reducing corporate fit-out budgets
mitigation: Diversify across industries — professional services, government, tech (different economic sensitivities)
Build a maintenance/refresh service offering for existing clients — smaller projects survive downturns better
Maintain strong cash reserve (8-week operating expense minimum)

riskResponseStrategies.avoid: Change the plan to eliminate the risk entirely
riskResponseStrategies.reduce: Take action to decrease the likelihood or impact
riskResponseStrategies.transfer: Transfer the risk to another party (insurance, contracts)
riskResponseStrategies.accept: Acknowledge the risk and manage it if it occurs — appropriate for low-score risks
